Computational physicist and research facilitator. I am based at [NCSA](https://www.ncsa.illinois.edu/), University of Illinois Urbana-Champaign, where I develop quantum algorithms for scientific simulation and study how classical and quantum hardware should share the work. I also help researchers and students use HPC, ML, and quantum computing for their domain applications. I have a PhD in physics from Iowa State University, where I worked on electroweak operators in chiral effective field theory.
